sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced: Q4 revenues expected down mid-teens, gross margins down 400-500 bps, and management explicitly stated headwinds will continue into fiscal 2026. The CEO acknowledged 'we are not satisfied with our overall results' and the CFO described the operating environment as 'dynamic' with multiple external uncertainties including tariffs and geopolitical risks. This constitutes a clear guidance reduction relative to prior expectations.

summary.guidance: Q4 revenues expected down mid-teens (low end), gross margins down 400-500 bps, SG&A up low to mid-single digits; headwinds expected to continue into fiscal 2026
key_risks: Classic footwear franchises (Air Force 1, Dunk, Air Jordan 1) declining faster than overall business
Inventory remains elevated across all geographies
Greater China traffic declined double digits and retail sales underperformed plan
Geopolitical dynamics, new tariffs, volatile FX, and impact on consumer confidence
Q4 guidance includes unfavorable shipment timing in North America and FX headwinds
Marketplace cleanup actions will continue through first half of fiscal 2026
key_opportunities: Performance business grew in Q3 led by running (mid-single digits) and training
New product launches (Pegasus Premium, Vomero 18) showing strong early sell-through
Wholesale order book in North America, EMEA, APLA shows growth in performance dimensions nearly offsetting classic declines
NIKE Digital reducing promotional days (from 30+ to zero in Jan/Feb North America)
Spring '26 product review generated excitement among partners

management_tone.label: mixed
management_tone.justification: CEO expresses confidence in strategic direction ('I'm even more convinced these are the right actions') while simultaneously acknowledging significant headwinds and a multi-quarter recovery timeline ('we are not satisfied with our overall results')
